description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“High Noon”, a luxurious retreat in the quaint coastal community of Sandy Shore, perfectly located between Rosemary and Alys Beaches. With Gulf views, a private heated pool, game room, and top-notch amenities, this 8-suite haven is ideal for large groups, sleeping up to 28 guests. Just a 1-minute walk to private community beach access with seasonal chair setup and 10 beach bikes, it's the ultimate getaway. Learn more below ...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf Views: Stunning views from the 2nd and 3rd-floor balconies!Private Heated Pool: Your personal outdoor oasis with a pool, gas grill, and ample seating.Summer Kitchen with Gas Grill: Perfect for outdoor dining and entertaining.8 Suites for up to 28 guests: Spread out in style across 5,000 sq ft of luxuryChef’s Dream Kitchen: Features a 6-burner gas range, dual refrigerators and dishwashers.Game Room: Enjoy a ping pong table, multi-player arcade, and more in the spacious family room.Elevator: Effortless access to all levels for maximum convenience.1-Min to the Beach: Private, community beach access just steps away.Seasonal Beach Chair Setup: Includes 2 chairs and 1 umbrella.10 Bikes Included: Explore the area with included bikes for the whole group. Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests: "The house was spacious, clean, and perfectly placed near everything we needed. It was a fantastic choice for our large group!" – Paul K."The location and amenities were absolutely perfect. Our multigenerational family vacation was a huge success!" – Christine C."This house is awesome! Great location, easy walk to private boardwalk to the beach. Beautifully decorated and heated pool. High-end house for sure!" – Marianne W.*** LIVING AREAS ***Welcoming you with lavish interiors and fine finishes, "High Noon" boasts a thoughtfully designed open-concept first floor. Enjoy spacious living, kitchen, and dining areas that seamlessly flow together, all complemented by chic coastal design and premium touches throughout. Step directly onto the expansive pool deck and relax or entertain in style and comfort.Spacious living room with sectional sofa and large TVBeverage station with mini-fridge and sink for convenience The second floor of "High Noon" is crafted with family enjoyment and relaxation in mind, offering a perfect retreat for all ages. Take the effortless elevator ride upstairs to discover a spacious family room, filled with entertainment options to create lasting memories. Whether you're watching a favorite show, engaging in friendly competition, or simply unwinding, this space delivers comfort and fun in equal measure.Sectional sofa, large smart TV, arcade, and ping-pong tableDrink bar with mini-fridge and sink for convenience*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***You'll love preparing gourmet meals for friends and family in this chef’s dream kitchen, complete with top-notch dual appliances, and plenty of counter space for effortless meal prep. After cooking, gather around the spacious dining table to share your creations, with additional seating available at the breakfast bar. This fully stocked kitchen and dining area are designed for making memories over delicious meals.Chef’s kitchen with 6-burner gas range, dual refrigerators and dishwashersDining table with seating for 12, plus additional seating for 5 at the breakfast barFully stocked for entertaining, serving, cooking, and meal prep*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Step into your own private oasis! From lounging by the pool to unwinding under the palms, this outdoor space offers the perfect setting for relaxation and entertaining.Private heated pool with tanning ledge, loungers, and shaded seating areasSummer kitchen with gas grill and dining areaPutting green for unforgettable evenings2nd floor oversized covered balcony with a porch swing for ultimate relaxation*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Primary Suite: King bed with en-suite featuring walk-in shower.Half Bathroom: Conveniently located on the 1st floor.2nd Floor:Primary Suite: King bed with dual vanity en-suite and walk-in shower.Queen Guest Suite: Queen bed with private en-suite and walk-in shower.King Guest Suite: King bed plus Twin bunk bed, tub/shower combo in en-suite (sleep 4).3rd Floor:Primary Suite (Right): King bed with a Queen-over-Queen bunk bed, en-suite featuring dual vanities (sleep 6).Primary Suite (Left): King bed, Gulf-view balcony access, and en-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower.Queen Guest Suite (Right): Queen bed, Twin-over-Twin bunk bed, and Queen-over-Queen bunk bed with private en-suite (sleep 8).Queen Guest Suite (Left): Queen bed with private en-suite.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in Seacrest Beach’s exclusive Sandy Shores, this home offers the perfect gateway to experience the best of 30A. Enjoy boutique shopping, gourmet cuisine, and a charming coastal community that’s perfect for biking! Neighboring hotspots like Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach are just a walk or bike ride away, while Peddler's Pavilion provides seasonal live music, dining, and nightlife.Private Community Beach Access just 150 steps awayPeddlers Pavilion: Short stroll awayAlys Beach: 3-minute walkRosemary Beach: 10-minute walkCarillon Beach: 7-minute drive*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be added during booking.We DO NOT accept wire transfers.Pool is heated September 1 - April 30A waiver must be signed to use the 10 provided bikes. Additional rentals available through 30A Escapes.Seasonal Beach Chair Setup (2 chairs + 1 umbrella) available March 6 - October 31.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.Parking for 4 vehicles!*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 97214STRO #: STR-097214
